record.title: Select dynamic falsification experiments from the recovered contract graph
record.intent: Spend guest experiments on unresolved selectors and behavior rather than deterministic software operations.
requirements: Combine userspace and kernel evidence into a bounded initialization contract graph and ranked ambiguity list.
Classify deterministic writes as static predictions; distinguish runtime-selected paths, hardware-returned reads, asynchronous behavior and unknowns.
Select whole deterministic regions for prefix/checkpoint validation and define immediate divergence stops.
Reevaluate the deferred 440-store transcript batch before allowing implementation or execution; revise or replace it when the graph supports a better boundary.
Preserve stock code, evidence provenance and synthetic-state labeling; do not claim FPGA behavior from kernel evidence.
acceptance: A small next batch targets named ambiguity boundaries with stated predictions and falsification criteria, rather than one task per known write.
Commit and push the static recovery and decision before the next guest experiment.
